content.text:
Because your opened entropy scan treats entropy as a **magnitude** signal, not a direction signal, I’d focus on content that teaches confirmation layers: cycle, rates, credit, liquidity, positioning, volatility, and cross-asset trend.

**Start In Your Vault**
- [2026-05-08_Entropy_Compression_Scan.md](</C:/Users/CaveUser/Documents/Obsidian Vault/My_Data/05_Data_Pulls/Market/2026-05-08_Entropy_Compression_Scan.md:715>) - especially “How to Read.”
- [Entropy Strategy Monitoring Cheat Sheet.md](</C:/Users/CaveUser/Documents/Obsidian Vault/My_Data/04_Reference/Entropy Strategy Monitoring Cheat Sheet.md:12>) - core rule, magnitude validation, confirmation stack.
- Local research notes to read next: `market_cycle_Core_Theory`, `Rates_Funding_Basis_Trade`, `Credit_ETF_Redemptions`, `Equity_Options_0DTE_Dealers`, and `Rebound_And_Breaking_Point_Playbooks`.

**Read**
- [CFA Institute: Capital Market Expectations, Part I](https://www.cfainstitute.org/insights/professional-learning/refresher-readings/2026/capital-market-expectations-part-i) - best framework for turning macro indicators into asset-allocation views.
- [Conference Board LEI](https://www.conference-board.org/topics/us-leading-indicators/) - useful for understanding composite leading indicators and their components.
- [Fed: Yield Curve Recession Probabilities](https://www.federalreserve.gov/econres/notes/feds-notes/predicting-recession-probabilities-using-the-slope-of-the-yield-curve-20180301.html) and [NY Fed Yield Curve](https://www.newyorkfed.org/research/capital_markets/ycfaq) - rates-cycle signal foundation.
- [Fed: Financial and Macroeconomic Recession Risk](https://www.federalreserve.gov/econres/notes/feds-notes/financial-and-macroeconomic-indicators-of-recession-risk-20220621.html) - combines term spreads, credit spreads, leading indicators, inflation, and unemployment.
- [ISM PMI Reports](https://www.ismworld.org/supply-management-news-and-reports/reports/ism-pmi-reports/) - new orders, prices, employment, supplier deliveries.
- [CFTC COT Explanatory Notes](https://www.cftc.gov/MarketReports/CommitmentsofTraders/ExplanatoryNotes/index.htm) - positioning.
- [Cboe VIX Products](https://www.cboe.com/tradable-products/vix) - volatility, hedging, implied vs realized vol.
- [AQR: A Century of Evidence on Trend-Following](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=2993026) and [AQR: Value and Momentum Everywhere](https://www.aqr.com/insights/research/journal-article/value-and-momentum-everywhere) - systematic macro/trend/factor backbone.

**Watch / Courses**
- [CME Institute](https://www.cmegroup.com/education) - futures, rates, FX, energy, commodities, economic-event trading.
- [Cboe Options Institute](https://www.cboe.com/optionsinstitute/) - options, index vol, risk management, derivatives positioning.

**Listen**
- [Top Traders Unplugged: Systematic Investor Series](https://www.toptradersunplugged.com/podcast-series/systematic-investor/) - trend following, CTA behavior, crisis alpha, vol clustering.
- [Macro Voices](https://www.macrovoices.com/) - global macro interviews with transcripts.
- [Forward Guidance](https://blockworks.com/podcast/forwardguidance) - current macro, liquidity, market structure, inflation and rates discussions.

Best order: CFA framework → LEI/ISM/Fed yield curve → Treasury/COT/VIX → AQR papers → podcasts for live regime context.
